metadata.scenario: After receiving an unexpected high bill, a customer calls in to dispute several charges they believe are incorrect. Category: Billing. Flags: billing_dispute.

transcription.text: Thank you for calling CareFirst Home Health, this is Margaret speaking. How can I help you today? Hi, Margaret. This is David Anderson. I’m calling about some unexpected charges on my bill. I’m sorry to hear that, David. Can you tell me which charges you’re concerned about? Yes, my wife just had some physical therapy and nursing care, but the bill seems unusually high. I understand. Let me pull up your account. Can you please confirm your wife’s name? Her name is Jennifer Anderson. Thank you, David. One moment while I check that for you. Alright, I see the charges. It looks like there were multiple therapy sessions billed at the higher end of the price range due to extended care. But I didn’t authorize those extra hours. We discussed a different amount during the consultation. I apologize for any confusion. Let's go through the details together. How many hours were you expecting for each session? We agreed on two sessions of physical therapy for an hour each. I see. The bill reflects additional time that was logged. Let me check the session notes. It appears the therapist recorded extra time for additional exercises. Did you feel those were necessary? That’s not what I was told. I need to dispute those additional hours. Absolutely, David. I can help you with that process. I’ll need to submit a formal dispute for you. Yes, please do. What do I need to provide to support this? Just your written consent stating the charges you dispute and any supporting details. I can send you an email with the template if that works for you. That sounds great. Thank you. You’re welcome. Also, would you be interested in scheduling a follow-up therapy session for Jennifer? Yes, I think she might benefit from more therapy. Perfect. We can coordinate that once we finalize the billing dispute. Alright, I appreciate your help, Margaret. Of course, David. I’ll make sure to follow up on this within 48 hours. Thank you, I’ll keep an eye out for your email. Thank you for your patience, David. Have a great day! You too, bye. Goodbye!
